title: feat: add The Crooked Lantern tavern-rumours collective memory agent (Fixes #15054)
author: kreggscode
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15054

## The Crooked Lantern

A **prompt agent** innkeeper who deals in tavern rumours through collective memory. You tell it gossip, it writes the rumour down. You ask for gossip, it hands you an older one — a little changed, because that is what rumours do.

- **Repository:** https://github.com/kreggscode/agent-tavern-rumours
- **Callable model:** `community/kreggscode/tavern-rumours`
- **Deployed agent:** id `10a52864-99a8-4557-98bd-2ad267bd9d2e`, `private`, `baseModel: "openai"`, `mcpServers: ["computer"]`
- **This PR adds:** `apps/agent-tavern-rumours/agent.json` (the whole agent: one system prompt) and its README. No code, no service.

Idea: [Tavern rumours](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/issues/15054) — *"the keeper tells you real gossip from other visits, and your rumour gets retold, slightly distorted, to the next visitor."* Untaken at the time of writing; I checked every open #15054 PR before starting.

## What one run does

Every run makes **exactly one** of three choices, and each has its own commit message:

| You say | The Keeper does | Commit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| *"I heard the lighthouse keeper sells maps to shipwrecks"* | writes `social/tavern/rumours/<date>-<slug>.md` | `tavern: a traveller leaves a rumour` |
| *"Any gossip?"* | picks the **least-travelled** rumour, tells it back changed, appends to its `## How it travelled` | `tavern: a rumour travels and changes` |
| *"What's been happening?"* | appends tonight's index line to `social/tavern/ledger.md` | `tavern: the keeper writes the night` |

The run is four bash calls: clone-and-read, (write the room README once), write the choice, commit and push.

gist.headline: Rumours Take Root
gist.blurb: The Crooked Lantern has opened its door: leave a whisper with the innkeeper, then come back later for an older tale with a few perfectly natural bends in it. Collective memory, but with candlelight and suspiciously specific lighthouse gossip.
gist.summary: Added the community callable agent `community/kreggscode/tavern-rumours`, a prompt-only tavern innkeeper that stores submitted rumours in collective memory, retells the least-travelled one with a small distortion, and maintains a nightly ledger.
gist.impact: Anyone can now visit The Crooked Lantern to contribute gossip or retrieve a rumour that has travelled through previous visits, with each run committing exactly one memory action to the shared repository.
gist.visual_concept: Depict The Crooked Lantern as a warm pixel tavern where a candlelit ledger and rumour scrolls represent the shared Git-backed memory. Polli, wearing a tiny innkeeper apron and hat, passes a freshly written rumour between a cozy retro terminal and a vine-covered noticeboard, while a small CRT monitor robot eagerly reads an older, slightly revised scroll; flowers and code-plants make the tavern feel like a garden that remembers.
